title: m2aitestkit
tagline: Offline regression tests for AI outputs: committed recordings, honest pass, fail and unevaluable outcomes, and assertion-level baseline diffs.
highlights: Three outcomes: a check that could not run is unevaluable, never a silent pass
Redacted, commit-friendly recordings that replay offline with no API key
Assertion-level baseline diff: pass to fail is a regression, removed checks are listed
Provider-independent, zero runtime dependencies, exit codes for CI
